# Stand-in plane

A synthetic three-wheeled flying `WheeledVehicleData` for tests: made-up
numbers, our own triangle meshes and a 1x1 blank texture, nothing from any
Add-On. It is 8.4 across the wings with a 1.6-wide body that collides:
wider than the 1x14x10 portal's opening, narrower than the 1x20x12's. Its
`damageEmitter`s name `StandInWreckEmitter` (not in the pack, so read as a
base-game emitter) twice; `standinsmokeemitter` is its own.
